overview.oneLineTake: A CoreWeave-led AI bounce offset hot inflation for a day, but near-certain Fed hike pricing and Nvidia leadership risk keep premium sellers cautious.
themes: The AI trade reignited Wednesday. CoreWeave jumped about 25% on a beat and raise, lifting AMD, Sandisk, Micron and other chip names. QQQ closed 690.38 (+2.31%) and SPY 759.81 (+1.32%).
Rates remain the overhang. Hot October CPI has December Fed hike odds near 100% per headlines, Goolsbee called the report borderline disturbing, and the 10-year sits near 5%.
Nvidia is the idiosyncratic risk. After a 5.5% drop Tuesday, WSJ reports the board is preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang, and tougher China export rules are being discussed ahead of earnings.
Anthropic set its IPO range at $70 to $78, with trading expected Nov 19. Brent briefly slipped below $90 on Iran hopes and US gasoline fell below $4.
risks: A hawkish Fed repricing with the 10-year near 5% is the main threat to equity multiples, and falling oil is no longer pulling yields lower.
Nvidia leadership turmoil, subpoena and export risk could hit the whole AI complex before earnings.
The rally leaned on a single earnings catalyst, so dip and rip swings can reverse fast.
Tariffs continue despite the midterm backlash, and record credit card debt of $1.29T points to consumer strain.

intelligence.headline: On the Move: Broadcom, AMD, Nvidia, CSG
intelligence.summary: Tech stocks rally in premarket trading on improving sentiment: Broadcom +3.6%, AMD +4.9%, Intel +4.1% and Marvell +6.4%. Storage and memory: Micron +5.6%, Sandisk +6.8%. Nvidia, which has tumbled almost 10% this week after its CEO was caught in a spy scandal, gains 3.4%. CSG plunges 17% in Amsterdam after the European arms maker cut its profitability outlook.

intelligence.headline: Traders Who Rushed to Safety of Bonds Get Rattled in Reversal
intelligence.summary: Fresh evidence of sticky inflation and hawkish comments from Fed officials combined on Tuesday to increase the odds of rate hikes and sent Treasuries into a tailspin, with two-year US yields soaring by the most in 19 months and 10-year yields briefly pushing back over 5%. Investors see a December rate hike as a done deal after Fed Governor Christopher Waller, speaking in London before the CPI report, warned that officials may need to raise interest rates by a half percentage point next month if there is no progress on inflation.

intelligence.headline: Fed's Goolsbee Says October CPI Report Is Borderline Disturbing
intelligence.summary: Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee called the October CPI report "another distressing report, borderline disturbing," said the Fed has to address rising prices, and called persistently high services inflation "perhaps the most troubling part" of the report.

intelligence.headline: Nvidia's Bull Case Hinges on CEO Surviving China Spy Probe
intelligence.summary: Nvidia has taken a hard knock from CEO Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese spy. Shares are now trading for less than 12 times estimated earnings, their lowest multiple since 2013.
